# Audit one page's SEO and AI-readiness in ten seconds

> Paste a page's HTML for a scored SEO and AI-readiness audit: title, description, headings, canonical, JSON-LD, alt text, each with its fix. Free, private.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/page-seo-audit/)
- [On-page SEO checklist for a single page](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/page-seo-audit/seo-checklist-for-a-single-page.html)
